description: Department of Local Government - Western Province - The Inquiry being Conducted under Section 02 of the Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns a judicial/law enforcement matter involving an inquiry board investigation into potential offenses by a local government body and its chairman. It involves a retired Court of Appeal judge conducting the investigation, focuses on legal proceedings under specific ordinances and acts, and deals with law enforcement procedures rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or other specialized categories.
